name: The Eighth Doctor
oracle_text:
When The Eighth Doctor enters, mill three cards.
Once during each of your turns, you may play a historic land or cast a historic permanent spell from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else."
blocked_sentences: Once during each of your turns, you may play a historic land or cast a historic permanent spell from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else."

needs.what: one graveyard-play permission whose once-per-turn cap is shared between playing a land and casting a permanent spell from your graveyard (historic = Artifact, Legendary supertype, or Saga subtype), on your turns only
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_graveyard (static_max_per_turn) and play_lands_from_graveyard are separate statics with separate meters, so writing both lets you play a historic land AND cast a historic spell in the same turn; neither can be told to spend the other's use

needs.what: a rider on a graveyard-play permission (like its enters_tapped rider) that gives the land or permanent played/cast under it the replacement "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_leaves_battlefield exists only as an op run by a resolving effect (Whip of Erebos, Spirit-Sister's Call); a static permission has no rider that applies it to the permanent that used the permission, and enters_tapped is the only such rider
